title: backlog.py answer refuses an answer that is none of the gate's options, naming them
goal: backlog.py answer ID GATE --answer TEXT exits 2 naming the options when the gate has options and TEXT is none of them (unless a flag says a free answer is meant), so a mistyped answer is not recorded as the operator's. Answers SP-evkj4avq, where an answer that reworded an option of ST-pvtfs43r's gate test-file was recorded and had to be answered again with the exact text.
